property_summary: The call to forward must succeed without reverting when the callee is a contract that does not revert on receiving the call; the buggy version always succeeds regardless of the callee's failure, but the reference also always succeeds when the callee succeeds, so we instead verify that forward() always returns without revert when callee is a functioning contract that accepts the call, while the buggy version also holds this property — this is a universal property both satisfy, so we need to distinguish based on the fact that the reference requires the internal call to succeed, while the buggy version does not. By calling a contract that always reverts, the reference reverts but the buggy does not.
change_summary: Remove the require check so that `forward` succeeds even on failed call, changing whether transaction reverts.
